sources.snippet: Overview DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-70B is a dense reasoning model created by deepseek-ai through knowledge distillation from the larger DeepSeek-R1 reasoning model. The model is built on the Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct base, fine-tuned with 800k reasoning samples generated by DeepSeek-R1.
